title: Riot Squad Punx Apple, Cucumber, Mint & Aniseed 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Experience the perfect balance of fresh and invigorating flavours with this Riot Squad Punx Apple Cucumber Mint & Aniseed 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid. Offering a sophisticated summer cocktail with a wild streak. The cool cucumber and crisp apples provide a refreshing base, and the hint of mint adds a subtle coolness. Whilst the addition of aniseed gives it an unexpected kick of warmth. Making for a truly unique and sophisticated vaping experience. This Riot Squad Punx Shortfill E-Liquid is perfect for vapers who crave a wild and exciting tasting vape. Order the Apple, Cucumber, Mint & Aniseed Punx by Riot Squad today to experience the perfect balance of fresh and invigorating flavours! This delicious Punx Apple Cucumber Mint & Aniseed by Riot Squad is also available as a Riot Squad Nic Salt. Which is perfect for vapers looking to soothe their nicotine cravings with a super smooth throat hit from the Riot Squad Punx E-Liquid range. Don’t miss out, check out the equally delicious Riot Squad Punx Apple, Cucumber, Mint & Aniseed Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml today! This convenient Riot Squad 50ml nicotine-free Shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a Nicotine Shot to tailor your vape to your liking. For example, adding an 18mg Nic Shot will turn your 50ml Riot Squad Shortfills into 50ml of 3mg E Liquid. What’s more, this Riot Squad Shortfill features a 70VG/30PG ratio. Making it ideal for Sub-Ohm Vape Kits. As it’s the perfect E Liquid ratio for large cloud creation that doesn’t lessen your vape juice flavour. Allowing you to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours to the max. Using naturally derived vegetable glycerine and propylene glycol with pharmaceutical-grade nicotine. Riot Squad’s Vape Juices are renowned for their supreme quality and ability to deliver huge flavoursome vapour clouds. So if you are looking for delicious flavour and high-quality E-Liquids for your vapes, you can be confident the Riot Squad UK-based E-Liquid manufacturer will deliver premium, flavourful vapour clouds and explosively delicious flavours in every puff! If you love this delicious Riot Squad Shortfill 50ml, then check out their other equally moreish 10ml & 50ml E-Liquids. Designed to suit any vapers flavour requirements, you’re bound to find a Riot Squad Vape juice you’ll love. Go ahead treat your taste buds to an explosion of juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverages, Confectionary/desserts, classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours from Riot Squad's delicious Black Edition, Menthol, BAR EDTN and Punx E-Liquid ranges. Love the flavour of Riot Squad Shortfills, but don’t want the hassle of refilling or maintaining your vape device? Check out the Riot Squad Disposable Vapes . These super convenient Disposable Vapes are a great way to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours on the go.
